pr_title: [DTS] Fix broken entity and links filtering (eg, admin data appearing in transfers)
pr_body:
### What does it do?

Fixes the entity and links filtering functions

### Why is it needed?

Only the last piped transform was being run

### How to test it?

Import/export/transfer should work correctly now and only transfer entities and links that are expected

Using the transfer engine directly should accept any number of map+filter transforms and they should all run in the correct order

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

Fixes https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/16845

## Bug report

### Required System information

<!-- Please ensure you are using the Node LTS version (v14 or v16 or v18) -->
<!-- Strapi v3 is not supported unless it is a critical/high security issue -->

- Node.js version: 16.13.2 (also tried 18.12.1)
- NPM version: 8.19.2
- Strapi version: 4.10.6
- Database: SQLite (same for Postgres)
- Operating system: Ubuntu 22.04.2 LTS
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: Typescript

### Describe the bug

Import operation duplicates users and roles if data was exported for project from itself.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Install strapi `npx create-strapi-app@latest new-project --quickstart`
2. Run export command `npm run strapi export -- --no-encrypt --file=./data`
3. Run import command `npm run strapi import -- --force --file=./data.tar.gz`
4. Go to the Setting->users and Settings->roles sections. Users and roles are duplicated now.

### Expected behavior

Roles and users are expected to be the same or be replaced by new records as it happens to objects of 'collection types'.

review_comments: Do we need this? Won't `stream` always be an instance of a stream (even if we're piping it to a chain)?
stream.pipe(chain) returns a Chain, that's why

We could probably do something everywhere we chain to convert it back to a PassThrough but it might just complicate things. We could also probably eliminate chain altogether and do some extra work in building the chains manually with PassThroughs. That's why I would like to clean this up, but I'm not sure I'll have time.
